title: Curse & Enchantment Extension
description: Adds more vanilla-like enchantments to the game for shulker boxes, buckets, and elytra.
body: ![header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0d4f3ae8c28ae9795fb61ba17fd5a565292268d.png) An extention to [Curse & Enchantment Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment_overhaul) ___ This pack extends enchantments to utility items like shulker boxes, buckets, and elytra. ## Eternal Makes the item unaffected by fire damage and despawning. Available for shulker boxes and bundles. ## Void Anything placed in this item ceases to be. Available for shulker boxes, bundles, and buckets. ## Source Makes the water bucket infinite. Available for water buckets. ## Photosynthesis The item regenerates durability when in strong sunlight. Available for elytra. ## Ethereal Grants [improved elytra flight in the end](https://modrinth.com/datapack/elytra-enchantments). Available for elytra. ## Decapitation Makes players drop their heads if killed with this item. ___ All enchantments are available through treasure, trade, and the enchanting table. An extension of **Curse and Enchantment Overhaul**. | | | |---|---| | [](https://modrinth.com/project/bucket-enchantments) | [](https://modrinth.com/project/shulker-box-enchantments) | | [](https://modrinth.com/project/elytra-enchantments) | [](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchantment_overhaul) |
